entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: This guy does stuff like vandalize[n]illegally-parked cars, or drop-kick[n]smokers in no-smoking areas...

entries.en: Did you figure anything out,[n][fName]?
His last name is Amasaki.
His screenname's an anagram.

entries.speaker: Ann

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Huh, okay. Anything else?
His full name's in his handle.
His handle's based on his name.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I see. So if we can unscramble the[n]anagram, we'll have his full name.
His last name is Amasaki.
Amasaki's his brother's surname.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Then all that remains is to[n]unscramble the whole thing.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So if he's A.I. Maask Ouzi... and[n]his last name's Amasaki...
That just leaves "Ouzi."
Maybe read it backwards...?
I give up.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Yes, you're right! Well done,[n][fName].

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wait... Oh yeah, so the AI Maask[n]part is just Amasaki!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Backwards? Dude, you expect me to[n]believe his name's Izuo Ksaamia?

entries.speaker: Makoto

entries.speaker: Ryuji

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I think I've figured it out.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: For real!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: He's separated his first and last[n]names into discrete parts.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: AI Maask comes out neatly to[n]Amasaki. That also explains the[n]extra "a" in the word.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: And Ouzi on its own can be read[n]backwards to find the name[n]"Izuo."

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Which means our target's name[n]is most likely Izuo Amasaki.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Just checked the Nav. We got[n]a hit!
